summary.headline: Dermatology network locks-in $1.18 M in annual savings across 12 spend categories
summary.narrative: Through two waves of strategic sourcing, Treya Partners delivered $1.18 million (≈19 % of $6.3 million baseline) of annual savings for APDerm.  Seven Phase-1 categories are either fully implemented or under final roll-out, while five additional Phase-2 categories have completed RFPs, vendor selection, and are in contract or implementation stages.  Key wins include a 27 % reduction on medical supplies with McKesson, a 17 % fee reduction with Athenahealth, and a consolidated janitorial program saving 20 %.  Most awards retained incumbents, enabling rapid savings realization with minimal operational disruption.
